summary: UI-1-A re-verification (iter13) — ALL acceptance checks PASS on live preview https://governance-scan-3.preview.emergentagent.com. (10) Clicking the sample in-progress row navigates to wizard; use-data-wizard-sample-banner present with text 'SAMPLE FIXTURE · This is seeded demo data (AS-U2). It is not a live commission.'. (11) Backend regression subset: 26/26 pass on tests/test_use_data_iter12_addendum.py + tests/test_use_data_http_iter11.py in 20.55s (full 1491-test suite not run due to iteration budget; no failures observed on scoped surface). (12) Frontend Jest UI-1-A gates: 3 suites (canon_os_root_vocab_gate, verdict_absolute_no_affordance_gate, sample_badge_rendered_location_gate) — 26/26 tests PASS.
